sources.title: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'
sources.publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) / National Informatics Centre (NIC), with STQC and CERT-In
sources.notes: Read from the official web edition (guidelines.india.gov.in/guidelines/ and /new-features-of-gigw-3-0/). Identifiers are the numbers the page renders (checked in a browser): 5.1.x Quality (25 items), 5.2.x Accessibility (50), 5.3.x Cybersecurity (3), 5.4.x Lifecycle management (10). The same counts and order appear in Annexure II 'Matrix to check conformity' (https://guidelines.india.gov.in/annexure-ii-matrix-to-check-conformity/), which uses 'Sl No.' 1..n within each area. The page prints the WCAG 2.1 reference beside each 5.2.x item. Included: a general Level AA statement (3.3), all 50 accessibility items, 19 Quality items and 8 Lifecycle items that relate to usability or content. Left out as government-only or internal process items: 5.1.1 (State Emblem), 5.1.4 (copyright permissions, checked in backend audit), 5.1.12 (National Portal link), 5.1.21 (gov.in/nic.in domain), 5.1.22 (government platform API integration), 5.1.24 (social media integration), 5.4.1 (WIM nomination), 5.4.2 (URL on stationery), and all of 5.3.x Cybersecurity.

sets.title: GIGW 3.0 (2023) – website accessibility, quality and lifecycle

items.title: Conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA
items.requirement: GIGW 3.0 accessibility guidelines are built to deliver WCAG 2.1 Level AA conformance, including the success criteria newly introduced in WCAG 2.1, for government websites and apps.
items.verification: Confirm the audit scope targets WCAG 2.1 Level AA across all pages and screens, with findings mapped to GIGW 5.2.1-5.2.50.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Text alternatives for non-text content
items.requirement: Every image and other non-text item needs an equivalent text alternative. Controls need descriptive names, CAPTCHAs need a described purpose and alternative modes, and decorative items should be hidden from assistive technology.
items.verification: Inspect alt text and accessible names for images, icons and controls; check CAPTCHA alternatives; confirm decorative images are ignored by screen readers.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Alternatives for audio-only and video-only media
items.requirement: Pre-recorded audio-only content needs a transcript, and pre-recorded video-only content needs a transcript or audio track, unless the media is itself a labelled alternative for text.
items.verification: List audio-only and video-only assets and confirm each has a transcript or audio alternative linked nearby.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Captions for pre-recorded media
items.requirement: Pre-recorded synchronised media with audio must carry captions covering dialogue, speaker identification and meaningful sounds, except when it is a clearly labelled alternative for text.
items.verification: Play each pre-recorded video; confirm accurate, synchronised captions include speakers and relevant sound cues.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Audio description or media alternative
items.requirement: Pre-recorded video in synchronised media must have either audio description or a full text alternative describing the visual content.
items.verification: Check each pre-recorded video for an audio-described version or a descriptive text transcript.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Captions for live media
items.requirement: Live audio delivered within synchronised media, such as webcasts, must be captioned in real time.
items.verification: Review live-stream setup or recordings for real-time captioning provision.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Audio description for pre-recorded video
items.requirement: All pre-recorded video content in synchronised media must provide audio description of important visual information.
items.verification: Confirm pre-recorded videos offer an audio-described track or version.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Info and relationships programmatically available
items.requirement: Structure and relationships conveyed visually, such as headings, lists, tables and form groupings, must also be available in code or text so assistive technology can convey them.
items.verification: Inspect semantic markup for headings, lists, tables and form labels; test with a screen reader.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Meaningful reading sequence
items.requirement: When the order of content affects its meaning, a correct reading order must be determinable programmatically.
items.verification: Linearise the page or use a screen reader to confirm reading order matches the visual and logical order.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Instructions not reliant on sensory characteristics
items.requirement: Instructions must not depend only on shape, colour, size, visual position, orientation or sound to be understood.
items.verification: Review instructional text for references like 'click the green button' or 'see right' without other identifiers.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No locked display orientation
items.requirement: Content must work in both portrait and landscape and must not be restricted to one orientation unless that orientation is essential.
items.verification: Rotate a phone or tablet on key pages and screens; confirm content displays and operates in both orientations.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Identify input purpose
items.requirement: Fields that collect the user's own information must expose their purpose programmatically, for example through standard autocomplete values, so browsers and assistive tools can help fill them.
items.verification: Inspect personal-data fields such as name, email, phone and address for correct autocomplete attributes.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Colour not sole means of information
items.requirement: Colour must not be the only visual way to convey information, indicate an action, prompt a response or distinguish an element.
items.verification: View pages in greyscale; check links, errors, charts and status indicators remain distinguishable.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Control for auto-playing audio
items.requirement: Audio that plays automatically for more than three seconds must be pausable or stoppable, or have volume control independent of system volume.
items.verification: Load pages and screens; confirm no audio autoplays beyond 3 seconds without an accessible pause, stop or volume control.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Minimum text contrast
items.requirement: Text and images of text need a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text, with exceptions for decorative text and logos.
items.verification: Measure foreground and background contrast of text with a contrast analyser across states and themes.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Text resizable to 200 percent
items.requirement: Apart from captions and images of text, text must resize up to 200 percent without assistive technology and without losing content or functionality.
items.verification: Zoom browser text to 200 percent (or use large OS font in app); confirm no clipped, overlapping or missing content.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Avoid images of text
items.requirement: Use real text rather than images of text where the technology allows. GIGW also asks organisations to OCR scanned PDFs so they contain actual text.
items.verification: Identify text rendered as images (banners, scanned PDFs); confirm real text or OCR'd text is available.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Reflow without two-dimensional scrolling
items.requirement: Content must reflow at a width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels without loss of information or functionality and without scrolling in two directions, except where 2D layout is essential.
items.verification: Set viewport to 320 CSS px (or 400 percent zoom at 1280px); confirm no horizontal scrolling for text content.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Non-text contrast
items.requirement: Visual boundaries and states of user interface components, and graphical objects needed for understanding, must have at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colours.
items.verification: Measure contrast of input borders, focus indicators, icons and chart elements against adjacent colours.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Text spacing overrides supported
items.requirement: When users increase line height, paragraph spacing, letter spacing and word spacing to the specified levels, no content or functionality may be lost.
items.verification: Apply a text-spacing bookmarklet or stylesheet; check for clipped, truncated or overlapping text.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Content on hover or focus
items.requirement: Extra content that appears on hover or focus, such as tooltips, must be dismissible without moving focus, hoverable, and stay visible until dismissed or no longer relevant.
items.verification: Trigger tooltips and pop-ups by mouse and keyboard; check Esc dismissal, pointer hover over popup, and persistence.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: All functionality keyboard operable
items.requirement: Every function must be operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific keystroke timing, except where the underlying function depends on the path of movement.
items.verification: Complete key journeys (login, forms, menus, dialogs) using only the keyboard or external keyboard/switch on apps.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No keyboard trap
items.requirement: If keyboard focus can move into a component, the user must be able to move it out again using the keyboard, with any non-standard method explained.
items.verification: Tab through all widgets, embeds and modals; confirm focus can always leave each component.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Character key shortcuts controllable
items.requirement: Single-character keyboard shortcuts must be possible to turn off or remap, or be active only while the relevant component has focus.
items.verification: Identify single-key shortcuts; confirm an option to disable or remap them, or that they act only on focus.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Adjustable time limits
items.requirement: Each time limit, such as a session timeout, must allow users to turn it off, adjust it or extend it, unless it is real-time, essential or longer than 20 hours.
items.verification: Trigger session or form timeouts; confirm a warning with an option to extend, or a configurable limit.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Pause, stop, hide moving content
items.requirement: Moving, blinking or scrolling content lasting over five seconds and auto-updating content shown alongside other content must offer a way to pause, stop or hide it.
items.verification: Check carousels, tickers and live price feeds for accessible pause/stop/hide controls.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No content flashing over three times
items.requirement: Pages must not include anything that flashes more than three times in any one-second period unless the flashing stays below general and red flash thresholds.
items.verification: Review animations and videos; use a flash analysis tool (e.g., PEAT) where flashing is present.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Bypass repeated blocks
items.requirement: Provide a way, such as a skip-to-main-content link or proper landmarks and headings, to skip blocks repeated across multiple pages.
items.verification: Press Tab on page load; confirm a working skip link, or landmark/heading navigation, bypasses headers and menus.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Descriptive page and screen titles
items.requirement: Each web page or app screen needs a title describing its topic or purpose. GIGW asks that home page titles be complete, giving the example of including the country name.
items.verification: Check the title element of each page and the screen title announced in apps for uniqueness and descriptiveness.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Logical focus order
items.requirement: Where sequential navigation affects meaning or operation, focus must move in an order that preserves both. GIGW also calls for correct tab and reading order in tagged PDFs.
items.verification: Tab through pages, dialogs and PDFs; confirm focus sequence follows a logical, meaningful order.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Link purpose clear in context
items.requirement: The link text alone, or the link text together with its programmatic context, must make each link's purpose clear, except where the purpose would be ambiguous to all users.
items.verification: List links with a screen reader; flag vague text such as 'click here' or 'read more' lacking context.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Multiple ways to find pages
items.requirement: Offer more than one way to locate pages, for example search plus a sitemap or table of contents. GIGW expects a search box or a search link on every page.
items.verification: Confirm a site search and a sitemap or equivalent index exist and are reachable from every page.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Descriptive headings and labels
items.requirement: Headings and labels must clearly describe the topic or purpose of the content or control, using a logical heading hierarchy.
items.verification: Review the heading outline and form labels for clarity and correct hierarchy.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Visible keyboard focus
items.requirement: Any keyboard-operable interface must show a visible focus indicator.
items.verification: Tab through all interactive elements; confirm focus is always clearly visible.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Single-pointer alternatives for gestures
items.requirement: Functions that use multipoint or path-based gestures, such as pinch or swipe, must also work with a single pointer without a path, unless the gesture is essential.
items.verification: Identify swipe, pinch and drag interactions; confirm button or tap alternatives exist.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Pointer cancellation
items.requirement: For single-pointer actions, avoid triggering on the down-event, or allow the action to be aborted or undone, or reverse it on the up-event, unless down-event activation is essential.
items.verification: Press and drag off controls before releasing; confirm actions do not fire on press alone.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Accessible name includes visible label
items.requirement: When a component has a visible text label, its accessible name must contain that visible text.
items.verification: Compare visible labels with accessible names in dev tools or accessibility inspector; test voice control.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Alternatives to motion actuation
items.requirement: Functions triggered by moving or shaking the device, or by user motion, must also be operable through interface controls, and motion triggering must be possible to disable.
items.verification: Identify shake or tilt features in apps; confirm on-screen alternatives and a setting to disable motion.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Default language identified
items.requirement: The default human language of each page must be set programmatically, for example with the lang attribute. For PDFs, GIGW points to the Lang entry in the document catalogue.
items.verification: Check the html lang attribute matches page language; check PDF document language property.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Language of parts identified
items.requirement: Passages or phrases in a different language must be marked with their language, except proper names, technical terms and words that have become part of the surrounding language.
items.verification: Find mixed-language content (e.g., Hindi within English pages); confirm lang attributes on those passages.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No context change on focus
items.requirement: A component receiving focus must not by itself trigger a change of context such as opening new windows, submitting forms or moving focus elsewhere.
items.verification: Tab onto every control; confirm nothing submits, navigates or opens unexpectedly on focus alone.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No unexpected context change on input
items.requirement: Changing a control's setting must not automatically change the context unless the user has been told beforehand. GIGW suggests using a submit button or giving advance notice.
items.verification: Change dropdowns, radio buttons and checkboxes; confirm no automatic navigation or submission without prior warning.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Consistent navigation order
items.requirement: Navigation mechanisms repeated across pages must appear in the same relative order each time, unless the user changes them.
items.verification: Compare header, menu and footer order across representative pages and screens.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Consistent identification of components
items.requirement: Components that do the same thing across a set of pages must be labelled and identified the same way.
items.verification: Compare labels and icons for repeated functions (search, download, login) across pages.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Input errors identified in text
items.requirement: When an input error is detected automatically, the field in error must be identified and the error described to the user in text, not only by colour or icon.
items.verification: Submit forms with invalid data; confirm text error messages identify fields and are announced by screen readers.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Labels or instructions for input
items.requirement: Wherever user input is required, provide labels or instructions that explain the expected input, including labels for individual options.
items.verification: Inspect every form field for a visible label and needed format hints (e.g., date, PAN format).
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Error correction suggestions
items.requirement: When an input error is detected and a correction is known, suggest the correction, unless doing so would compromise security or the purpose of the content.
items.verification: Enter wrongly formatted data; confirm messages suggest how to fix it.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Error prevention for legal/financial submissions
items.requirement: Submissions that create legal commitments, financial transactions or user data changes must be reversible, checked for errors, or open to review and correction before final submission.
items.verification: Walk through transactions, orders and account changes; confirm a review/confirm step, undo, or validation exists.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Well-formed markup
items.requirement: Markup must have complete start and end tags, correct nesting, no duplicate attributes and unique IDs, except where specifications allow otherwise. GIGW expects developers to validate their markup.
items.verification: Run an HTML validator and check for duplicate IDs and nesting errors on key templates.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Name, role, value exposed
items.requirement: All interface components, including custom scripted widgets, must expose their name, role, states and values to assistive technology and notify it of changes.
items.verification: Inspect custom widgets in accessibility tree; test with screen readers (NVDA, TalkBack, VoiceOver) for correct announcements.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Status messages announced
items.requirement: Status messages, such as success or result notices, must be conveyed to assistive technology through roles or properties without moving focus.
items.verification: Trigger search results, cart or save confirmations; confirm screen readers announce them via live regions.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Ownership information on key pages
items.requirement: Show ownership information on the home page and important entry pages or screens. Every page should stand on its own for ownership, navigation and context.
items.verification: Check header or footer of home and deep-linked pages for owning organisation name and navigation back to home.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Cite source of reproduced documents
items.requirement: Documents reproduced in whole or part that the organisation does not own must name their source, giving the full title, the owning organisation and the year of publication.
items.verification: Sample third-party documents and excerpts; confirm source title, owner and year are stated.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Last updated or reviewed date
items.requirement: Show the date content was posted, last reviewed or last modified, on the home page and on important entry pages or screens.
items.verification: Confirm a visible last updated/reviewed date on the home page and key landing pages.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Details for downloadable files
items.requirement: Each downloadable file must come with a self-explanatory title, file format, file size and instructions for using it. Files should be small and checked for malware.
items.verification: Sample download links; confirm title, format and size are shown, plus usage or help information.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Metadata for circulars, notices, forms
items.requirement: Every circular, notification, document, form, scheme, service or notice must list its full title, its language if not English, the purpose or procedure to apply, and its validity where relevant.
items.verification: Sample circulars, notices and forms listings for title, language, purpose/procedure and validity fields.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Remove or archive outdated content
items.requirement: Remove expired announcements, tenders, recruitment notices, news and press releases, or move them to an archive in line with the archival policy.
items.verification: Check announcement, news and notice sections for expired items outside the archive.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: About us section
items.requirement: Provide an About us section with useful information about the organisation, and have a way to keep it current.
items.verification: Confirm an About us page exists, is linked, and content is current.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Contact us page
items.requirement: Provide a Contact us page with full contact details of key functionaries, including phone, postal address, email and any public-dealing hours. Link it from the home page and relevant pages.
items.verification: Confirm Contact us page is linked from home and key pages and lists complete contact details.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Online feedback with timely response
items.requirement: Collect feedback through online forms and have a process that responds to feedback and queries in good time.
items.verification: Locate the feedback form, test submission and acknowledgement; review response-handling records.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Cross-browser and regional font testing
items.requirement: Test the website on multiple browsers. Check Hindi and regional-language text, which should use Unicode, on popular browsers for layout breakage.
items.verification: Test key pages in major browsers, including regional-language versions; check layout and Unicode rendering.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Help section linked from all pages
items.requirement: Link a Help section from every page in a consistent location. It should cover navigation, file formats, plug-ins, audio/video access and site policies.
items.verification: Confirm a Help link appears consistently on all pages and covers navigation, formats and plug-ins.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: CSS layout and responsive design
items.requirement: Use CSS to control layout and presentation, and use a responsive design so the interface displays well on different screen sizes and devices.
items.verification: Inspect for CSS-based layout; test at mobile, tablet and desktop widths.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Readable with style sheets disabled
items.requirement: Content must stay readable and in a sensible order when style sheets are turned off or fail to load.
items.verification: Disable CSS via browser tools; confirm content is readable and logically ordered.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Page title, language attribute, metadata
items.requirement: Every page needs an appropriate title, a language attribute and metadata such as a description and keywords.
items.verification: Inspect page head for title, html lang and meta description/keywords on sampled pages.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Minimum content on home and inner pages
items.requirement: The home page should give the organisation name, logo, about information, major sections, services, Contact us, Feedback, search or sitemap, and terms. Inner pages need a title, home and parent links, ownership and Contact us.
items.verification: Checklist the home page and sampled inner pages against the prescribed minimum elements. Ignore government-only items such as the National Portal link.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Data table markup
items.requirement: Do not use tables for layout. Data tables must mark up row and column headers and associate data cells with their headers.
items.verification: Inspect data tables for th, scope or headers attributes and captions; check no layout tables.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Prints correctly on A4
items.requirement: Web page content must print correctly on A4 paper.
items.verification: Use print preview on A4 for key pages; confirm no truncated or overlapping content.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Consistent experience across properties
items.requirement: Keep information architecture, navigation, terminology and visual identity consistent across all of the organisation's websites and apps.
items.verification: Compare navigation, terminology and branding across the organisation's website, portals and apps.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Free from spelling and grammar errors
items.requirement: Published content must contain no spelling or grammatical errors. It should be checked manually or with tools before publishing, with CMS support.
items.verification: Run spelling/grammar checks on sampled pages; review pre-publication checking process.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Publish citizen-facing website policies
items.requirement: Define and approve a set of website policies and plans. Citizen-facing ones, namely copyright, privacy, and terms and conditions, must be published on the website.
items.verification: Confirm copyright, privacy and terms pages are published and linked; request approved policy set.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Hyperlink accuracy and external-link notice
items.requirement: Check the accuracy of linked content regularly, and clearly alert visitors when a link takes them to an external website.
items.verification: Click sampled external links; confirm an external-site notice or indicator; review link-check records.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No offensive or discriminatory content
items.requirement: Use a content moderation and approval workflow to keep website content free of offensive or discriminatory language.
items.verification: Sample published content; confirm CMS moderation/approval workflow exists.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Multilingual versions updated together
items.requirement: Update all language versions of documents and pages at the same time, and show the status of content not yet translated.
items.verification: Compare sampled pages across language versions for parity and dates; check untranslated-content notices.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No broken links or 404 errors
items.requirement: Check regularly for broken internal and external links and 'page not found' errors, and fix or remove them as soon as they are found.
items.verification: Run a broken-link crawler across the site; review periodic link-check records.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: No 'under construction' pages
items.requirement: Do not publish or link to pages marked 'under construction' or 'work in progress'. Event-based content should carry a date.
items.verification: Crawl for 'under construction'/'coming soon' placeholders and empty pages.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Documents in HTML or accessible formats
items.requirement: Publish documents in HTML or another accessible format, and provide accessible versions of all scanned documents.
items.verification: Sample PDFs and documents for tagging, real text (not scans) and screen-reader readability, or HTML equivalents.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

items.title: Bilingual with prominent language selector
items.requirement: The website or app should be at least bilingual, use Unicode for regional languages, and give a prominent language selector so users can choose a language before entering.
items.verification: Confirm a visible language switcher, Unicode regional text, and translated key content.
items.sourceTitle: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0), 2023 - web edition, chapter 5 'Guidelines' and section 3 'New features of GIGW 3.0'

sets.title: SEBI digital accessibility circulars (2025–2026)
sets.publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India

items.title: Accessible digital KYC per SEBI PwD FAQ
items.requirement: Intermediaries must make their services, including digital KYC and account opening, digitally accessible to clients with disabilities, following SEBI's revised FAQ on Account Opening by Persons with Disabilities.
items.verification: Walk through online account opening and KYC with assistive technology; compare process against SEBI's PwD account-opening FAQ.
items.sourceTitle: Accessibility and Inclusiveness of Digital KYC to Persons with Disabilities - Circular SEBI/HO/MIRSD/SECFATF/P/CIR/2025/74 dated May 23, 2025

items.title: Comply with RPwD Act accessibility provisions
items.requirement: All digital platforms of regulated entities must comply with RPwD Act 2016 Sections 40, 42 and 46 and with Rule 15(1)(c) of the RPwD Rules 2017, as amended.
items.verification: Confirm the RE's accessibility policy and audit scope cite the RPwD Act sections and Rule 15(1)(c) for every investor platform.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Follow WCAG 2.1 or later
items.requirement: Digital platforms and the content published on them must strictly follow WCAG 2.1 or its latest version as a baseline for all digital initiatives.
items.verification: Check audit reports state the WCAG version tested (2.1 or later) and cover all digital platforms.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Follow latest GIGW accessibility guidelines
items.requirement: Digital platforms and their content must also follow the accessibility guidelines in the latest version of GIGW.
items.verification: Confirm the audit maps findings to GIGW accessibility items (currently GIGW 3.0 section 5.2).
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Follow IS 17802 (BIS ICT accessibility)
items.requirement: Digital platforms and their content must also meet IS 17802, the Indian standard on ICT accessibility requirements. That standard's text is not reproduced here.
items.verification: Confirm the RE or auditor has assessed conformance against IS 17802 using a licensed copy of the standard.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Board-level approval and Nodal Officer
items.requirement: The MD, Managing Partner or Proprietor must review and approve compliance. A senior officer must be designated Nodal Officer; if none is named, the Compliance Officer or Proprietor is treated as Nodal Officer.
items.verification: Obtain the approval record from the MD, Managing Partner or Proprietor and the Nodal Officer designation document.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Nodal Officer responsibilities
items.requirement: The Nodal Officer must ensure accessibility for every investor by overseeing audits, fixing audit findings, applying the guidelines and resolving grievances on time, and acts as SEBI's contact point for accessibility.
items.verification: Review the Nodal Officer role description, audit oversight records and grievance-resolution tracking.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Accessibility-specific grievance redressal mechanism
items.requirement: Set up a grievance mechanism specifically for accessibility issues. Its channels, such as email, helpline and web forms, must be easy for persons with disabilities to use and must allow escalation to senior officers.
items.verification: Locate accessibility grievance channels on site/app; test the web form's accessibility; confirm a documented escalation path.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Report compliance to designated authority
items.requirement: Report compliance with the circular to the reporting authority assigned to the RE under the circular's reporting arrangements.
items.verification: Confirm submissions were made to the correct authority (exchange/depository, BSE Ltd., or SEBI) with acknowledgement.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: ISL, captions, audio description, alt text
items.requirement: Digital platforms must offer Indian Sign Language videos, closed captions, descriptive audio and image alt text. For example, a KYC explainer video should have captions and ISL interpretation.
items.verification: Sample videos (especially KYC explainers) for captions, ISL interpretation and audio description; check images for alt text.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Accessible circulars, notices and investor documents
items.requirement: Circulars, notices and investor documents on websites or apps, in PDF or other formats, must be accessible: tagged, in logical reading order, with proper headings and alt text, following W3C PDF techniques.
items.verification: Check sampled PDFs with a PDF accessibility checker and screen reader for tags, reading order, headings and alt text.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Accessibility training; accessible by design
items.requirement: Internal training for staff and third-party vendors who build or publish digital content must include accessibility modules covering design, assistive tools and inclusive experience. Platforms should be accessible by design.
items.verification: Review training curricula, attendance records for staff and vendors, and design-stage accessibility checks.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Alternative modes for digital KYC
items.requirement: Digital KYC, e-KYC and video KYC must offer alternatives for users with disabilities, for example human-assisted video KYC, uploading scanned documents, or voice-assisted KYC for visually impaired users.
items.verification: Test KYC journeys for available assisted alternatives (human-assisted video, scanned upload, voice assistance) and how to request them.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Disability status field and assistance options
items.requirement: KYC and client registration forms must have a mandatory field for disability status, plus options to choose specific support such as a helpdesk call-back.
items.verification: Inspect registration/KYC forms for the mandatory disability-status field and selectable assistance options.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Human review before rejecting PwD applications
items.requirement: An application from a client with a disability may be rejected only after review by a designated human officer, who can override automated rejections and approve on a case-by-case basis.
items.verification: Review the onboarding SOP, designated officer appointment and override logs for PwD applications.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Comprehensive audit through IAAP professionals
items.requirement: Start a comprehensive accessibility audit of websites, mobile apps and portals through IAAP-certified professionals. It must follow the latest WCAG, GIGW, the RPwD Act and Rules, and SEBI directions.
items.verification: Verify auditor IAAP credentials, audit scope covering all platforms, and the standards listed in the audit methodology.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Usability testing by persons with disabilities
items.requirement: The accessibility audit must include usability testing carried out by persons with disabilities.
items.verification: Check the audit report documents usability testing sessions with participants with disabilities and their findings.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Remediation plan for audit findings
items.requirement: Prepare and carry out a remediation plan that addresses the audit observations.
items.verification: Review the remediation plan, issue tracker and retest evidence against each audit observation.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Upgrade existing platforms within transition timeline
items.requirement: Upgrade existing digital platforms to meet the accessibility standards within the transition timeline.
items.verification: Compare remediation completion dates for existing platforms with the applicable SEBI deadline (currently 31 Oct 2026).
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Annual audits by IAAP-certified professionals
items.requirement: Audit the accessibility of websites, mobile apps and portals every year through IAAP-certified professionals, and submit the reports through the mechanism in direction 1.4.
items.verification: Confirm an annual audit schedule, current-year IAAP audit report and proof of submission.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Accessible procurement and SaaS conformance
items.requirement: New or procured digital solutions must meet the latest WCAG, IS 17802, GIGW and the RPwD Act. SaaS vendors must audit their products against WCAG 2.1 or later. Accessibility responsibility stays with the RE.
items.verification: Request vendor accessibility audit reports or conformance statements for SaaS and procured solutions.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Accessibility in RFPs and contracts
items.requirement: Put accessibility requirements into every RFP and procurement contract, and give accessibility readiness proper weight in evaluation criteria.
items.verification: Sample recent RFPs and contracts for accessibility clauses and evaluation weightage.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Original implementation milestones (superseded)
items.requirement: Original milestones: list platforms and file a compliance/action-taken report within 1 month, appoint IAAP auditors within 45 days, audit within 3 months, remediate within 6 months. Later circulars changed these.
items.verification: Historical reference only; assess against revised dates in circulars 2025/121, 2025/187 and 17922/2026.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Annual compliance reporting within 30 days
items.requirement: Report compliance every year within 30 days of financial year-end. Brokers and DPs report to exchanges or depositories, IAs to BASL (later changed), and MIIs and other REs to SEBI.
items.verification: Confirm the annual compliance submission date and recipient authority match the current reporting table.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Applicable from date of circular
items.requirement: The circular has applied to all regulated entities since its issue date, 31 July 2025.
items.verification: Confirm the entity is a SEBI-regulated entity and treats the obligations as in force since 31 July 2025.
items.sourceTitle: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules made thereunder - mandatory compliance by all Regulated Entities - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated 31.07.2025

items.title: Platform list and action-taken report deadline
items.requirement: The deadline for submitting the compliance/action-taken report and the list of investor-facing digital platforms moved from 30 Aug 2025 to 30 Sept 2025.
items.verification: Check proof of submission of platform list and action-taken report on or before 30 Sept 2025.
items.sourceTitle: Extension of timelines and Update of reporting authority for IAs and RAs w.r.t. SEBI Circular for Compliance to Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/121 dated August 29, 2025

items.title: Auditor appointment deadline extended (later replaced)
items.requirement: The deadline to appoint IAAP-certified professionals as auditors moved from 14 Sept 2025 to 14 Dec 2025. Circular 187/2025 later replaced this with a readiness status report.
items.verification: Historical reference; see sebi-2025-187 Para 3(a) for the replacement obligation.
items.sourceTitle: Extension of timelines and Update of reporting authority for IAs and RAs w.r.t. SEBI Circular for Compliance to Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/121 dated August 29, 2025

items.title: Audit and remediation deadlines extended
items.requirement: The accessibility audit deadline moved to 30 April 2026 and the deadline for remediating findings moved to 31 July 2026. Both were extended again in July 2026.
items.verification: Historical reference; current deadline for both is 31 Oct 2026 per circular 17922/2026.
items.sourceTitle: Extension of timelines and Update of reporting authority for IAs and RAs w.r.t. SEBI Circular for Compliance to Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/121 dated August 29, 2025

items.title: Annual audit compliance from April 2027
items.requirement: Annual compliance on conducting accessibility audits of all digital platforms, with the final audit report submitted to SEBI, is first due on 30 April 2027, within 30 days of each financial year-end.
items.verification: Confirm planning for an annual audit cycle with first annual submission by 30 April 2027.
items.sourceTitle: Extension of timelines and Update of reporting authority for IAs and RAs w.r.t. SEBI Circular for Compliance to Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/121 dated August 29, 2025

items.title: Reporting authority for IAs and RAs
items.requirement: Investment Advisers and Research Analysts now report digital accessibility compliance to BSE Ltd. Brokers and DPs report to exchanges or depositories, and MIIs and other REs report to SEBI.
items.verification: Confirm the RE category and that submissions went to the correct reporting authority.
items.sourceTitle: Extension of timelines and Update of reporting authority for IAs and RAs w.r.t. SEBI Circular for Compliance to Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/121 dated August 29, 2025

items.title: Compliance submission dates for SEBI-direct REs
items.requirement: REs reporting directly to SEBI: platform list by 30 Sept 2025, auditor appointment by 14 Dec 2025, audit by 30 Apr 2026, remediation by 31 Jul 2026, annual compliance from 30 Apr 2027.
items.verification: Compare submission records with these dates, noting later changes by circulars 187/2025 and 17922/2026.
items.sourceTitle: Compliance Guidelines for Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/131 dated September 25, 2025

items.title: Submit to SEBI by email; consolidate reports
items.requirement: REs reporting directly to SEBI must email submissions to digital_acc@sebi.gov.in in the Part C formats. REs with several platforms must send consolidated audit reports.
items.verification: Check sent-mail evidence to digital_acc@sebi.gov.in using prescribed subject lines and consolidated reports.
items.sourceTitle: Compliance Guidelines for Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/131 dated September 25, 2025

items.title: Digital platform inventory format
items.requirement: Submit an inventory of digital platforms giving each platform's name, URL, purpose and remarks on its current accessibility status, together with the RE's name and category.
items.verification: Verify the inventory lists every investor-facing website, app and portal with URL, purpose and status remarks.
items.sourceTitle: Compliance Guidelines for Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/131 dated September 25, 2025

items.title: Auditor appointment details format
items.requirement: Report the IAAP-certified auditor's name, IAAP ID or certificate number, appointment date, audit scope, contact details, and whether the auditor was told about the SEBI circular.
items.verification: Cross-check auditor IAAP certificate validity and that audit scope covers all listed platforms.
items.sourceTitle: Compliance Guidelines for Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/131 dated September 25, 2025

items.title: Initial audit report submission format
items.requirement: The initial audit submission must give the auditor or firm, completion date, platforms covered with terms of reference and scope, key findings as a consolidated PDF named per the convention, and a remediation action plan.
items.verification: Check the submission includes all Table C3 fields, consolidated PDF with correct file name, and remediation timelines.
items.sourceTitle: Compliance Guidelines for Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/131 dated September 25, 2025

items.title: Final audit report submission format
items.requirement: The final audit submission must give the auditor, completion date, scope, final findings as a consolidated PDF, remediation measures, compliance status (fully, partially or pending) and supporting evidence such as screenshots or certificates.
items.verification: Confirm final report shows remediation evidence and a declared compliance status per platform.
items.sourceTitle: Compliance Guidelines for Digital Accessibility Circular - Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/131 dated September 25, 2025

items.title: Digital accessibility right in Investor Charters
items.requirement: SEBI will add the investors' right to digital accessibility to the Investor Charters it publishes for the various categories of regulated entities.
items.verification: Check whether the investor charter displayed by the RE reflects the latest SEBI version including digital accessibility rights.
items.sourceTitle: Clarification on the Digital Accessibility circulars of SEBI - Circular HO/13/19/13(2)2025-ITD-1_VIAP/I/187/2025 dated December 08, 2025

items.title: Readiness status report by 31 March 2026
items.requirement: Instead of appointing an auditor by 14 Dec 2025, REs must report each platform's accessibility readiness and compliance status to their reporting authority by 31 Mar 2026. SEBI-reporting REs use digital_acc@sebi.gov.in.
items.verification: Obtain the readiness status submission and acknowledgement dated on or before 31 March 2026.
items.sourceTitle: Clarification on the Digital Accessibility circulars of SEBI - Circular HO/13/19/13(2)2025-ITD-1_VIAP/I/187/2025 dated December 08, 2025

items.title: Readiness report format (WCAG AA yes/no)
items.requirement: For each investor-facing platform, the readiness report lists the URL, whether it meets at least Level AA of the latest WCAG (Yes/No), and remarks on readiness and compliance.
items.verification: Check each listed platform's Level AA claim against audit evidence; flag unsupported 'Yes' entries.
items.sourceTitle: Clarification on the Digital Accessibility circulars of SEBI - Circular HO/13/19/13(2)2025-ITD-1_VIAP/I/187/2025 dated December 08, 2025

items.title: SCORES accessibility complaints and remediation
items.requirement: Investors can file accessibility complaints against REs on SCORES under its 'Accessibility' category. To close such a complaint, the RE must fix the underlying accessibility issue.
items.verification: Review SCORES accessibility complaints, closure notes and evidence that each reported issue was remediated.
items.sourceTitle: Clarification on the Digital Accessibility circulars of SEBI - Circular HO/13/19/13(2)2025-ITD-1_VIAP/I/187/2025 dated December 08, 2025

items.title: Periodic audits by certified professionals
items.requirement: REs must audit the accessibility of their websites, mobile apps and portals periodically through certified accessibility professionals.
items.verification: Confirm a recurring audit schedule and auditor certification evidence.
items.sourceTitle: Clarification on the Digital Accessibility circulars of SEBI - Circular HO/13/19/13(2)2025-ITD-1_VIAP/I/187/2025 dated December 08, 2025

items.title: Audit and remediation extended to 31 Oct 2026
items.requirement: The deadline to conduct accessibility audits of digital platforms and fix the findings is extended to 31 October 2026. All other provisions of the earlier circulars stay in force.
items.verification: Confirm audit completion and remediation evidence dated on or before 31 October 2026; other obligations remain tracked.
items.sourceTitle: Extension of timelines with respect to compliance of Digital Accessibility Circulars - Circular HO/(411)2026-ITD-5_DIV2/I/17922/2026 dated July 31, 2026
